title: Optimized protocol for mouse footpad immune cell isolation for single-cell RNA sequencing and flow cytometry
protocol: Anesthetize mice with isoflurane.
Sacrifice mice by cervical dislocation.
Cut foot above the ankle and remove skin.
Transfer deskinned footpad in 15 mL conical tube containing digestion media.
Filter dissociated tissues through 70 μm cell strainer.
Aliquot 5 ml of freshly prepared digestion media into a 15 mL conical tube containing glass beads.
Shake vigorously for 2 hours at 37°C in a benchtop shaker.
Manually shake the mixture every 15 minutes if a shaker is not available.
Pass tissue digests through a 70 μm cell strainer by pouring mixture directly onto the strainer fitted in a 50 ml tube.
Wash the strainer with 10 ml cold 10% RPMI-1640 media.
Pellet cells by centrifuging at 400 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C and remove supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellet into 3 ml 10% RPMI-1640 media at room temperature.
Mix mono-poly medium well by inverting it 3–5 times before use.
Add 3 ml of mixed mono-poly medium to a sterile 15 ml conical tube.
Carefully layer 3 ml footpad cell solution onto the M-P medium.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 30 minutes in a swinging bucket rotor at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Collect cell layers between RPMI-1640 media and M-P M.
Add collected cells to a 15 mL conical tube containing 10 mL cold FACS buffer.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Resuspend in 1 mL FACS buffer.
For CD45 positive selection, supplement FACS buffer with 2 mM EDTA.
Prepare Selection Cocktail from EasySep Mouse CD45 Positive Selection Kit.
Add 100 μL of cocktail (50 μL of component A + 50 μL of component B) for each 1 mL sample.
Prepare Selection Cocktail fresh before each use.
Add 100 μl of Selection Cocktail per ml of sample, mix well and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Vortex RapidSpheres™ from EasySep Mouse CD45 Positive Selection Kit for 30 s.
Add 50 μl of RapidSpheres™ per 1 ml of sample, mix well and incubate at room temperature for 3 min.
Add 2.5 ml FACS buffer to the tube, gently pipette up and down 2-3 times to mix.
Place the tube on a magnet and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Pick up the magnet, invert the tube into a waste container without shaking or blotting off drops.
Repeat the separation steps three more times, each for 5 minutes with cells in 2.5 ml FACS buffer.
Remove the isolated cell-containing tube from the magnet.
Resuspend cells in 1 ml FACS buffer.
Collect all cells by resuspending them from the sides of the tube.
Take 10 μL suspended cells + 10 μL 0.4% trypan blue, mix.
Use microscope or automated cell counter to count cells and determine viability percentage.
Prepare the following items before starting the cell fixation: increased centrifuge speed from 200 × g to 400 × g.
Resuspend cell pellet by flicking after removing the supernatant but before adding cell buffer.
Make 1% BSA solution in sterile water.
Add 15 mL 1% BSA solution to each tube.
Incubate for 30 min at room temperature.
Pour BSA out of the tubes and use a P1000 pipette to remove remaining BSA.
Air dry for 30 min with uncapped tubes in the biosafety cabinet.
Transfer up to 4 million cells into a BSA coated 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge tubes at 4°C for 400 × g for 10 min.
Prepare 1 mL of cell buffer containing 0.5% BSA per sample in a separate tube.
Carefully remove the supernatant and fully resuspend pellet in 750 μL of cold cell buffer containing 0.5% BSA.
Pipette cells through a 40 μm strainer into a new 15 mL conical tube.
Place cells back on ice.
Add 250 μL of cold fixation solution.
Mix by pipetting up and down exactly 3 times with the pipette set to 250 μL.
Wait 10 min with cells on ice.
Add 80 μL of cold permeabilization solution.
Mix by pipetting up and down 3 times with a P1000 set to 250 μL.
Wait 3 min with cells on ice.
Invert the tube five times to mix neutralization buffer provided with Evercode cell fixation V2 kit.
Add 4 mL of cold neutralization buffer.
Gently invert the tube once to mix.
Place cells back on ice.
Centrifuge tube in swinging bucket centrifuge at 4°C set to 400 × g for 10 min.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant using a P1000 pipette.
Resuspend cells in cell buffer using a P1000 pipette and place back on ice.
If more than 500,000 cells were started with, resuspend in 300 μL of cell buffer without BSA.
If fewer than 500,000 cells were started with, resuspend in 150 μL of cell buffer without BSA.
Pass cells through a 40 μm strainer into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube with a P1000.
Keep samples on ice.
Label Eppendorf tubes with key identifying information such as experiment number, pathogen and tissue name, date of collection, researcher initials.
Add 5 μL of DMSO if starting with more than 500,000 cells.
If starting with fewer than 500,000 cells, add 2.5 μL of DMSO.
Gently flick the tube three times to mix and wait one minute on ice.
Repeat the addition of DMSO two more times for a total volume of 15 μL if starting with more than 500,000 cells.
For fewer than 500,000 cells, add a total of 7.5 μL of DMSO.
Mix the final suspension by gently pipetting up and down five times with a P200 to ensure thorough mixing.
Set the P200 to 150 μL if starting with more than 500,000 cells.
If fewer than 500,000 cells are used, set the P200 to 75 μL.
Place tubes containing cells into a Mr. Frosty or similar device for controlled cooling at around -1°C/min.
Transfer the cooled tubes to a -80°C freezer for storage.
Load 8333 fixed footpad cells from each sample.
Perform three rounds of barcoding followed by lysis to isolate barcoded cDNA.
Prepare sub libraries from the isolated barcoded cDNA.
Sequence the prepared sub libraries to generate 30–60 thousand reads per cell.
Transfer up to 1 × 10^6 cells from each sample into a V bottom 96 well plate.
Pellet cells by centrifuging at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Wash cells with 200 μL PBS.
Dilute Zombie aqua dye at 1:400 in PBS.
Resuspend cells in diluted 100 μL Zombie aqua solution.
Incubate the cells at room temperature, in the dark, for 30 min.
Add 100 μL FACS buffer.
Pellet cells by centrifuging at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL Fc antibody solution (1 μg per one million cells).
Incubate for 15 min on ice.
Keep one sample as an unstained control.
Prepare combined antibody solution for each sample.
Mix CD45, CD11b, Ly6G, and Ly6C antibodies in a cocktail for innate immune cells gating.
Mix CD45, CD3, CD4, and CD8a antibodies in a cocktail for adaptive immune cells gating.
Add 100 μL FACS buffer containing antibodies to each sample.
Resuspend cells and incubate on ice for 30 min in dark.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Add 200 μL FACS buffer, pellet cells by centrifuging at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Wash cells with 200 μL FACS buffer.
Resuspend cells in 200 μL 4% formalin and incubate for 30 min at room temperature in dark.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Wash cells twice with 200 μL FACS buffer.
Resuspend cells in 200 μL PBS.
Cover plate in aluminum foil.
Analyze cells using a flow cytometer equipped with the necessary lasers and detectors.
